tui_pin.carrier: dsh-plugin.json compat.hosts + dsh-distribution.json host-tui ref + docker lanes + tui-mount TUI_HOST_SPEC

subject.why_tui_moved: measured peer bands: dsh-tui 0.17.0 declares 39 @deepseek-ai/* peers; 36 are dsh-* OR-lists and ALL 36 stop at 0.2.1-rc.3 (0 admit rc.4/rc.5). dsh-tui 0.18.0 has the same 39/36 shape and ALL 36 contain 0.2.1-rc.4 AND 0.2.1-rc.5. A TUI pin whose peer band excludes the harness pin is REFUSED by `dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add` (AGENTS.md §8), so the pair must move together.

failing_signature: SKILLS=fail:mpd-dsh-adapter: harness service "skills" is unavailable — cannot list skills
baseline_flake_before_fix.verdict: version-INDEPENDENT (rc.3 reddened as often as rc.5); NOT a compatibility regression

root_cause.defect: the case killed the dsh child on HTTP readiness and read the probe verdict post-mortem
root_cause.measured_window: http-200 -> verdict = 751-752 ms (instrumented copy, 3 rc.5 runs)
root_cause.mechanism: SIGTERM disposes cordis services while the probe's async apply is still asserting, so its later reads see an empty registry and the adapter reports the skills service as unavailable

fix.change: the readiness loop no longer breaks on HTTP 200 alone; it breaks only once the boot log already carries /roles-probe\] (PASS|FAIL)/, still inside the existing 120000 ms deadline and 2000 ms poll
fix.side_effect: none on assertions; worst case adds one 2 s tick; an absent verdict still falls through to the deadline and fails

after_fix.boot_signature: TOOL_PARAM_SCHEMAS=52/52, SKILLS=19 BUNDLED=19, AGENT_TEAMS_TOOLS=2/7 on every run

qa_lane.cross_version_note: the post-fix runs included harness 0.2.1-rc.4 while the tree pins 0.2.1-rc.5 — i.e. the rc.5-pinned bundle mounts, boots, serves, uninstalls and re-composes on an rc.4 host (the DSH Go phone case)
